from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class CompanyCapitalInfo(BaseModel):
    """One company's capital reserve information from its financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name from the financial report")
    capital_reserve: float | None = Field(description="Capital reserve amount (资本公积) in yuan")
    category: Literal["高资本", "中资本", "低资本", "无资本"] | None = Field(description="Capital category based on task-defined thresholds: 高资本>1B, 中资本500M-1B, 低资本<500M, 无资本<=0")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyCapitalInfo]
